preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz?' for c in stdin.splitlines()[0])
preconditions.description: The first line of input (s) consists only of lowercase Latin letters and question marks.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.splitlines()[1])
preconditions.description: The second line of input (t) consists only of lowercase Latin letters.
The length of s is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).
The length of t is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).
The product of the lengths of s and t does not exceed 10^7.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the maximum number of occurrences of t in s after replacing all question marks.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) - len(t) + 1 for i in range(len(s) - len(t) + 1))
postconditions.description: For every possible starting index i in s (where s[i:i+len(t)] is a substring of length len(t)), the substring s[i:i+len(t)] can be compared to t after replacing all question marks in s.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout) == max(sum(1 for i in range(len(s) - len(t) + 1) if (s[i:i+len(t)].replace('?', 'a') == t or any((s[i:i+len(t)].replace('?', c) == t) for c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz')))), key=lambda x: x)
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum number of occurrences of t in s achievable by replacing all question marks in s with any lowercase Latin letter. The occurrences can overlap.
